reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I searched the workspace brain, and nothing there backs up her tip. There's no mention of a Linden rollout or of Oriel Brevik at Marrow Fieldworks. The only Marrow Fieldworks record I found is a January 2026 Central team handoff note, and it doesn't name a contact.

My reply said I couldn't confirm the tip, that I'd treat it as unverified rather than as the account's main contact, and that the Marrow Fieldworks account owner is the person to ask if she wants it confirmed. The brain still has her message saved as she wrote it, including that it's unverified.
